# QR Code generator (C++), vendored

- Upstream: Project Nayuki, https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Version: v1.8.0, files `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`, unmodified.
- Licence: MIT, see `LICENSE` (also in the header of both files).

Used by *Open in VR Headset…* to draw the QR code of the pairing page
(`src/app/VrPairQr.h`). To update, replace the two files with a newer release
and keep this note in step.
